questions.stemHtml: A 22 year old male presented with progressive left sided facial swelling for 2 weeks. There is history of traumatic injury with wood two months back. CECT nose and paranasal sinuses shows mass in subcutaneous tissue of left cheek. Biopsy of specimen shows foreign body granuloma with positive PAS and GMS stain. What is the diagnosis?
